content.overview: Every Producer Company shall in each year hold an annual general meeting, and not more than fifteen months shall elapse between one AGM and the next. The Registrar may extend the time for holding any AGM (other than the first) by not more than three months. The first AGM must be held within ninety days of incorporation. Members adopt the articles and appoint directors at the AGM. The notice must be accompanied by the agenda, previous minutes, names and qualifications of director candidates, audited accounts and Board report, and the other documents listed in the section. The AGM shall be called during business hours on a day that is not a public holiday and held at the registered office or at some other place within the city, town or village in which the registered office is situate.
content.glance: AGM every year (max 15 months gap); first AGM within 90 days; notice with prescribed documents; held at registered office or same city/town/village during business hours on a non-holiday.
content.study: Section 378ZA governs the timing, content of notice, and place of the annual general meeting of a Producer Company. The first AGM is due within ninety days of incorporation. Subsequent AGMs must be held so that no more than fifteen months elapse between meetings, subject to a limited Registrar extension. The section also lists the documents that must accompany the notice and the place and time rules for the meeting.
